lro.criteria: low Sun: |beta| >= 55 deg (incidence >= 55 deg at low latitude); near noon: |beta| <= 15 deg
lro.method: beta angle from the node and inclination of the tracking-based elements (to 2026-09-02 TDB) extrapolated with a degree-2 node trend fitted to the final 730 days (linear inclination trend); start_range and end_range span the central fit and alternative fits (degree 2 over 548 days, degree 2 over 1095 days, degree 1 over 365 days); season dates are UTC calendar days sampled at 12:00 TDB
lro.note: orbit-plane condition from tracking-based Horizons elements extrapolated beyond 2026-09-02 TDB; it assumes no orbit manoeuvre and does not guarantee a target pass, operations or a before/after pair
lro.horizons_prediction_not_used: the Horizons prediction after 2026-09-02 regresses the node at -0.023 to -0.004 deg/day against -0.090 to -0.118 deg/day in the observed spans (accelerating), which marks it as a low-fidelity placeholder

danuri.criteria: low Sun: |beta| >= 55 deg (incidence >= 55 deg at low latitude); near noon: |beta| <= 15 deg
danuri.method: beta angle from the node and inclination of the tracking-based elements (to 2026-09-29 TDB) extrapolated with a degree-1 node trend fitted to the final 300 days (linear inclination trend); start_range and end_range span the central fit and alternative fits (degree 2 over 300 days, degree 1 over 180 days, degree 1 over 730 days); season dates are UTC calendar days sampled at 12:00 TDB
danuri.note: orbit-plane condition from tracking-based Horizons elements extrapolated beyond 2026-09-29 TDB; it assumes no orbit manoeuvre and does not guarantee a target pass, operations or a before/after pair

prediction_check.note: KARI prediction in the Horizons record (not used for the seasons) versus the extrapolation of the tracking-based elements

danuri.baseline: not available after its planned March 2028 lunar impact
danuri.source_plan: KASA press release, 10 February 2025 (planned lunar impact in March 2028 after low-altitude landing-technology tests)
danuri.sensitivity: continued operation after March 2028 (changed plan) with the same assumed availability
